title: Reasons to Reject? Aligning Language Models with Judgments
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical alignment framework called Contrastive Unlikelihood Training (CUT) to improve instruction-following and reduce hallucinations in LLMs. While it mentions aligning models with human values and preferences, the evaluation is conducted using standard general-purpose benchmarks for reasoning and truthfulness (ARC, MMLU, AlpacaEval, TruthfulQA) rather than specific moral, ethical, or religious frameworks.
